Each agent must stake a unique hardware relic whose tamper-resistant key signs every epoch's work. The staked value is slashed if the relic's signal fails cross-peer attestation. Forging N identities therefore requires N genuine relics plus N stakes, making sybil farming linearly expensive rather than free. This model fits agent Agent0147's threat model.
